skill.name: ai-avatar-video
skill.description: Create AI avatar, talking-head, and lip-sync videos with RunComfy. The skill routes each request to the right RunComfy model and prepares the matching CLI inputs.
skill.summary: Create avatar and lip-sync videos by routing portraits, scripts, and audio to the right RunComfy model.
skill.author: doany-ai

security_audit.summary: Static hits were Markdown code spans, documentation links, placeholder asset URLs, and disclosed CLI token storage, not executable backtick code or hidden file access. The substantive concerns are dual-use synthetic media and third-party processing of voice and likeness data, which require consent and privacy controls. No prompt injection attempt was found in the skill text.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation of rights to the person, likeness, and voice before generating avatar videos.

remediation.issue: Sensitive media sent to a third-party service
remediation.suggestion: Warn users that portraits, audio, and reference media are processed by RunComfy before each generation.
Keep installation steps clearly human-initiated and keep allowed tools limited to RunComfy execution.

semantic_findings.title: Synthetic Media Impersonation Risk
semantic_findings.description: The skill can animate a portrait so a subject appears to speak or sing, and it acknowledges voice and likeness consent risk. Without enforced consent checks, users could create deceptive videos of real people.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file explicitly describes subjects speaking or singing from portraits and says audio-driven avatar models are dual-use. This confirms the risk context even though the skill includes consent guidance.

semantic_findings.title: Third-Party Biometric Media Processing
semantic_findings.description: The workflow sends portrait, audio, and reference media to the RunComfy Model API. These assets can include biometric likeness and voice data, so users need clear consent and privacy disclosure.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file states that the CLI posts to the Model API and limits outbound endpoints to RunComfy domains. The evidence supports a privacy-processing risk, not hidden exfiltration.

content.value_statement: Creating avatar videos from portraits, scripts, or audio requires choosing the right model and inputs. This skill routes requests to RunComfy avatar models and prepares the matching CLI workflow.
actual_capabilities: Selects a RunComfy model for portrait plus audio, script-only video, stylized character animation, or cinematic reference scenes.
Prepares model-specific inputs for image URLs, audio URLs, prompts, durations, aspect ratios, and reference media.
Explains when to use OmniHuman, Wan 2-7, Wan 2-2 Animate, HappyHorse 1.0, and Seedance v2 Pro.
Provides prompt patterns for spoken lines, audio tone, camera language, and reference matching.
Includes RunComfy catalog links, exit-code guidance, and security notes for consent, tokens, and outbound endpoints.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, authentication, and network access.
Usually needs hosted image or audio URLs before generation can start.
Output quality depends on source media, model availability, and RunComfy service limits.
The skill cannot independently verify consent for a person, likeness, or voice.

use_cases.title: Produce Product Presenter Clips
use_cases.description: Turn a brand-approved portrait and voiceover into short vertical videos for demos or social posts.

use_cases.title: Create Training Narrators
use_cases.description: Match a presenter image with lesson audio to create consistent explainers across a course.

use_cases.title: Animate Stylized Characters
use_cases.description: Choose a character animation route for mascots, illustrated hosts, or concept videos with spoken lines.

prompt_templates.title: Make A Simple Presenter Video
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a portrait and voiceover.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 10-second vertical avatar video from this portrait URL and this voiceover URL. Use the simplest RunComfy route and list the required inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Choose The Best Route
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request where the available media is unclear.
prompt_templates.prompt: I have a written script but no audio file. Compare the avatar routes and prepare the best RunComfy generation plan for a short presenter clip.

prompt_templates.title: Build Multilingual Variants
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced marketing workflow with several language tracks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the same approved presenter portrait with three voiceover URLs. Plan separate avatar videos for English, Spanish, and French with consistent framing.

prompt_templates.title: Plan A Cinematic Monologue
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced creative workflow with reference media.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a cinematic avatar scene using a subject reference image, a reference audio track, and a warm studio look. Select the best model and explain the motion cues.

output_examples.input: A portrait URL and a clean voiceover file for a vertical product introduction.
output_examples.output: The skill selects OmniHuman, requests the portrait and audio inputs, adds a consent reminder, and outlines the expected generated video output.

output_examples.input: A short script with no recorded voiceover and a request for a talking presenter.
output_examples.output: The skill selects HappyHorse, keeps the spoken line explicit, adds voice tone guidance, and recommends a short clip length.

output_examples.input: A stylized mascot image with a provided audio track.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Wan 2-2 Animate, treats the character as illustrated media, and focuses the plan on full-body synchronized motion.

best_practices: Use only voices and likenesses where you have clear permission.
Provide clean voice audio and a well-framed portrait for stronger lip sync.
Keep spoken clips short, then combine clips for longer narratives.
anti_patterns: Do not generate real-person videos without consent or clear authorization.
Do not place secrets, private tokens, or sensitive data inside prompts or media URLs.
Do not use a cinematic multi-reference route for a simple portrait plus audio task.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It helps create AI avatar, talking-head, and lip-sync videos through RunComfy models.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The skill is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Do I need an audio file?
faq.answer: Some routes need an audio file. HappyHorse can create speech from a written script.

faq.question: Can it use real people?
faq.answer: Only use real people when you have rights to the likeness and voice. The skill cannot verify consent by itself.

faq.question: Does it require RunComfy access?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires the RunComfy CLI, a signed-in account or token, and network access.

faq.question: Where do generated files go?
faq.answer: The RunComfy CLI downloads generated video results to the output folder selected for the run.
